name: dev-pipeline
description: Autonomous pipeline from an intaken ticket to a reviewed PR: /dev-pipeline:run drives run.sh, a scheduler that commits the intake record as the branch's first commit, runs fresh build and review sessions, runs the configured checks itself, and accepts only a verdict comment naming the current head. /dev-pipeline:review is the manual review; pr-revision answers human PR comments. Tracker adapters (github|jira), a cost block on the PR. Reads per-repo static context from .claude/second-shift.config.json.
